articles.desc: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they made of this year's Budget.

articles.title: Godrej Consumer Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 523 crore, revenue jumps 19%; co declares Rs 5/share dividend
articles.desc: Godrej Consumer Products posted 13.8% profit growth to ₹522.92 crore and 19% revenue growth to ₹4,413.09 crore in Q2 FY27. Strong international performance, expanding home care brands and a ₹5 interim dividend supported its outlook for sustained growth.

articles.title: Government should support both job-creating and frontier industries: EAC-PM chairman Dev
articles.desc: S Mahendra Dev highlighted the importance of supporting job-creating and frontier industries for future economic growth. He mentioned that sectors like textiles and technology can significantly enhance India's industrial landscape. The need for improved competitiveness and product quality in various firms was also emphasised. Furthermore, land availability and global supply chain shifts present unique opportunities for India. Overall, addressing these challenges is crucial for the country's industrial transformation ahead.

articles.title: Suzlon Energy Q2 Results: Profit plunges 69% YoY to Rs 394 crore due to one-time deferred tax
articles.desc: Suzlon Energy reported a 69% year-on-year profit decline to ₹394 crore in Q2 FY27, despite 26% revenue growth to ₹4,869 crore. Record turbine deliveries, a 6,009 MW order book and a ₹2,048 crore net cash position strengthened its outlook.

articles.title: ESAF Small Finance Bank posts Rs 160 crore Q2 profit as asset quality improves
articles.desc: ESAF Small Finance Bank reported a net profit of Rs 160 crore in Q2, reversing a Rs 116 crore loss in the year-ago period. Improved margins, lower provisions and stronger asset quality supported the turnaround, while advances and deposits grew 25% and 24%, respectively.

articles.title: Trent Q2 Results: Cons profit jumps 25% YoY to Rs 468 crore; revenue climbs 22%
articles.desc: Trent Q2 Results: Trent reported a 25.3% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 468 crore, while revenue grew 21.9% to Rs 5,873 crore. EBITDA rose 29.6% to Rs 1,054 crore, with margins improving to 18.2%. The retailer expanded its footprint across Westside, Zudio and other lifestyle concepts.

articles.title: 10 defence stocks rally up to 500% in FY27 so far; 5 turn multibaggers
articles.desc: India’s defence stocks have outperformed the Nifty 50 in FY27, with the sector index rising 22%. The top 10 performers gained 43–513%, including five multibagger stocks.

articles.title: Rupee rises 3 paise to close at 95.25 against US dollar
articles.desc: The Indian rupee appreciated by 3 paise to reach 95.25 against the US dollar. It started the day at 95.20 but hit an intra-day low of 95.38. Positive domestic market trends and declining crude oil prices helped stabilize the currency. Analysts expect the rupee to face pressure due to a strong dollar and hawkish Federal Reserve signals. The dollar index rose slightly, while Brent crude oil prices were down.

articles.title: IndiGo Q2 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 1,879 crore; revenue rises 26%
articles.desc: IndiGo Q2 Results: Budget airline IndiGo reported narrowing of its consolidated loss to Rs 1,879 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 2,582 crore in the year-ago quarter. However, the loss widened from Rs 237 crore posted in the preceding June quarter.

articles.title: Global Market: European shares edge higher ahead of ECB policy decision
articles.desc: European shares edged higher as gains in energy and aerospace stocks offset weakness in technology shares ahead of the ECB’s policy decision. Shell and Airbus advanced following their earnings updates, while investors awaited signals from ECB President Christine Lagarde on the interest-rate outlook.

articles.title: Tata Power, JSW Energy, Torrent Power: Ambit sees buying opportunity in power stocks after valuation reset
articles.desc: Ambit Capital sees the recent correction in power stocks as a re-entry opportunity, favouring Tata Power, JSW Energy and Torrent Power. Rising electricity demand, fresh capacity contracting and limited PPA visibility could drive the sector’s next growth phase.

articles.title: Bajaj Electricals exec chairman Shekhar Bajaj to become non-executive board member from January
articles.desc: Bajaj Electricals executive chairman Shekhar Bajaj will step down from his current role by the end of 2026 after leading the company for four decades. He will transition to a non-executive board position from January 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval. The move is part of the company’s shift towards a professionally managed, board-led governance model, it said.

Inside, engineers create the force behind our phones and computers and appliances, our streaming services and search engines and chatbots and vibe-coded apps and websites. The complex is simultaneously massive and squat, dwarfed by the mountains that surround it, and it is endless. I drive past one […]

articles.title: Microsoft, Oracle outshine Alphabet as investors demand AI returns
articles.desc: Wall Street increasingly favours technology companies demonstrating financial discipline in AI investments. Microsoft and Oracle gained on strong cash flow prospects, while Alphabet shares plunged amid rising capital expenditure and slower search growth. Investors are prioritising sustainable returns, profitability and cash generation over aggressive artificial intelligence infrastructure expansion.

articles.title: Equentis Wealth Advisory Services leads investor awareness drive against equity market fraud
articles.desc: Equentis Wealth Advisory Services held a crucial investor awareness seminar in Bengaluru, focusing on the rising threat of cybercrime and online investment scams. With Dr. Satyapal Singh as the Chief Guest, expert speakers outlined current fraudulent strategies and emphasized the importance of investor vigilance. Participants were encouraged to rigorously check investment platforms and recognize deceptive online advertising.

articles.title: Dean of valuation Aswath Damodaran pegs Anthropic's worth at $1.475 trillion ahead of mega IPO
articles.desc: Aswath Damodaran values Anthropic at $1.475 trillion ahead of its anticipated IPO, but warns that compute costs, slowing revenue growth, and competition could alter its outlook. His scenarios range from a negative $373 billion to $4.04 trillion in equity value.

articles.title: Abolish LTCG, rationalise STCG, STT rates on equities: PHDCCI to Finance Ministry
articles.desc: PHDCCI has recommended abolishing Long Term Capital Gains tax and modifying short-term capital gains taxes. The chamber suggests increasing the holding period for long-term investments to attract genuine investors. It emphasizes that current tax structures discourage investment due to double taxation on equities. Foreign Portfolio Investors have withdrawn significant funds from Indian equities, impacting investment levels. Government analysis of these recommendations may lead to changes in tax policy and structure.

articles.title: As crypto markets mature, technical analysis moves to the core of investor strategy
articles.desc: Crypto investing has evolved from hype-driven participation to a focus on technical analysis and structured decision-making. Investors are now using tools to analyze price movements and market trends effectively. Technical analysis helps investors remove emotions from trading and create a repeatable system for decision-making. Additionally, many traders combine technical analysis with fundamental research to inform their investment choices.

articles.title: Global Market: Japanese investors extend foreign bond selling streak to six weeks
articles.desc: Japanese investors extended their selling streak in foreign long-term bonds to six weeks, although falling US Treasury yields slowed outflows. Meanwhile, they increased short-term bill purchases and foreign stock investments, while overseas investors returned to Japanese equities.

articles.title: RIL Q2 Results Preview: Profit outlook brightens as O2C business set to drive growth
articles.desc: Reliance Industries is expected to report 15-17% year-on-year growth in September-quarter EBITDA, driven by a sharp recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business. Brokerages expect stronger refining margins, higher throughput and a weaker rupee to offset subdued retail and oil and gas performance. Investors will track O2C profitability, Jio Platforms’ earnings and retail margins as RIL announces results.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan bond yields steady ahead of BOJ policy decision
articles.desc: Japanese government bond yields remained largely steady ahead of the Bank of Japan’s policy decision on Friday, supported by strong demand at a two-year bond auction and gains in US Treasuries. Markets expect the BOJ to hold rates steady, while a Reuters poll points to a possible 25-basis-point hike in December.

articles.title: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: Net profit tanks 90% YoY to Rs 114 crore on tax reversal effect; revenue rises 10%
articles.desc: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: The company reported a 90% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 114 crore due to a Rs 1,697 crore income tax provision reversal in the year-ago quarter. Revenue rose 10% to Rs 6,113 crore. Shareholders also approved the proposed amalgamation of ACC and Orient Cement with Ambuja, with completion expected in FY27, subject to approvals.

articles.title: Finance ministry estimates India’s Q2 FY27 GDP growth at 7.35%
articles.desc: The finance ministry’s nowcasting model estimates India’s GDP will grow 7.35% in Q2 FY27, following 7.8% growth in the previous quarter, supported by stronger industrial output, energy consumption, port traffic, GST collections and automobile sales.

articles.title: Pine Labs shares jump 7% as Q2 net profit soars 543% YoY to Rs 39 crore
articles.desc: Pine Labs shares rose sharply on Thursday after the fintech company reported a 543% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 38.6 crore. Revenue rose 24% to Rs 806.2 crore, while EBITDA increased 67.3%. Growth in payments, UPI transactions and international markets supported performance as the company expands into AI-led commerce.

articles.title: Asian Paints Q2 Results: Net profit rises 7% YoY to Rs 1,068 crore; firm announces Rs 5.75/share dividend
articles.desc: Asian Paints Q2 Results: The paint maker reported a 7% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,068 crore, while revenue grew 17% to Rs 9,977 crore. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 per share, with November 4 set as the record date, even as shares fell 2%.

articles.title: Govt extends Amnesty Scheme under ESIC for three month till December 31
articles.desc: The ‘New Amnesty Scheme 2025’, rolled out on October 1, 2025, is a one-time dispute resolution initiative aimed at reducing the backlog of court cases and promoting compliance under the erstwhile Employees’ State Insurance Act. Court cases filed up to March 31, 2025 are eligible under this scheme, the ministry said on Thursday.

articles.title: Central Asia's biggest state makes renewed push for infrastructure & AI projects
articles.desc: Kazakhstan President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev outlined plans to strengthen energy security, expand infrastructure, develop artificial intelligence and improve living standards in his October 28 state-of-the-nation address.

articles.title: IIT Kharagpur and Absolute launch Smart Scout AI project for soybean farming
articles.desc: Absolute and IIT Kharagpur are developing an early warning system for soybean farmers to minimize crop losses. The Smart Scout project aims to detect lodging risks, assess damage, and estimate yields using artificial intelligence. This initiative is part of the Quad-backed AI-ENGAGE program focusing on agricultural innovations. Pilot trials will be conducted across major soybean-growing states in India over the next three years.

articles.title: ACME Solar shares rally 5% after Q2 profit jumps over 100%, signs 400MV agreement with NTPC
articles.desc: ACME Solar shares rose 5% after its Q2 FY27 profit surged 133.5% to ₹269 crore and revenue climbed 67.5% to ₹1,007 crore. The rally was also supported by its subsidiary signing a 25-year power purchase agreement with NTPC for a 400 MW renewable energy project.

articles.title: Jio Platforms is becoming more than a telecom company: Dolat Capital
articles.desc: Jio Platforms is poised to evolve beyond telecom as tariff hikes, 5G monetisation, home broadband and enterprise digital services drive its next growth phase, according to Dolat Capital. The brokerage initiated coverage with an Accumulate rating and a target price of Rs 1,435, citing strong growth prospects and rising free cash flow.

articles.title: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defence systems amid war in Tigray
articles.desc: The acquisition of the warplanes comes amid ongoing fighting in northern Tigray region that started last month.

articles.title: Michael Burry says Anthropic IPO papers show AI industry is 'catastrophically vulnerable'. What the 'Big Short' investor sees
articles.desc: Investor Michael Burry warned that Anthropic’s planned IPO exposes serious vulnerabilities in the AI industry, citing massive infrastructure commitments, slowing growth and mounting costs. The investor, known for predicting the 2008 financial crisis, believes disappointing AI revenues could trigger a significant market correction and capital losses.

articles.title: Can Asia keep growing as oil and debt bite? IMF’s Krishna Srinivasan explains
Anthropic IPO sparks betting frenzy on prediction markets

Platforms Polymarket and Kalshi have attracted millions in trading volume, reflecting strong AI investment interest while highlighting uncertainty surrounding valuations and investor demand.

articles.title: Jio Q2 Preview: First results after listing tomorrow. What should investors expect?
articles.desc: Jio Platforms will announce its first quarterly results as a listed company on October 30, with brokerages expecting double-digit revenue growth in Q2 FY27. Nomura projects revenue of Rs 40,400 crore and net profit of Rs 7,610 crore, while subscriber additions and ARPU growth will be key metrics for investors.

articles.title: US Market: Fed holds rates steady, but bond investors remain concerned over inflation
articles.desc: The US Treasury yield curve steepened after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference, as investors weighed inflation risks, fiscal concerns and the outlook for interest rates. Longer-dated bond yields faced pressure amid worries over government borrowing and the term premium. Mixed economic signals also raised questions about the Fed’s growth assessment, while markets continued to price in the possibility of further rate hikes.

articles.title: India will gain strong comparative advantage after US trade deal: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted India's potential advantages from a trade deal with the United States. He asserted that the agreement would not harm the interests of farmers or any other stakeholders involved. Goyal made these statements during the 4th ISID-IDRA National Conference in Delhi. The trade deal aims to enhance India's economic landscape and strengthen its global standing.

articles.title: Alphabet's heavy cloud spending drives bigger-than-expected cash burn
articles.desc: The company reported negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion, compared with analysts' estimate of a cash burn of $36 million, according to data compiled by LSEG.

articles.title: STMicro nearly doubles quarterly profit, sees Q4 sales exceeding $4 billion
articles.desc: STMicroelectronics reported a third-quarter operating profit above market expectations on Thursday, as demand from AI data centres and satellite operators added to a broader recovery in the chipmaker's markets.

articles.title: Marvell in advanced talks to buy Lumentum: Bloomberg News
articles.desc: Marvell has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, driven by strong demand for its custom AI chips and networking hardware that connect data center servers and artificial intelligence systems.

articles.title: Global Market: China stocks fall as tech selloff deepens despite Fed rate pause
articles.desc: Chinese stocks declined as a sharp selloff in technology and AI-related shares outweighed the US Federal Reserve’s decision to keep interest rates unchanged. The Shanghai Composite fell 0.9%, while the CSI300 dropped 1.2% and the STAR50 tumbled 4.2%.

articles.title: India is addressing Wall Street’s favourite ‘elephant’ in the room to its own advantage
articles.desc: The Indian government has identified 762 potential applications of artificial intelligence across 62 ministries and departments, spanning farming, railway safety, tax compliance, public grievances, customs and healthcare. While some tools are already in use, others remain in pilot or development stages.

articles.title: HUL shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Jefferies, Nomura cut target price but forecast 29% upside potential
articles.desc: Hindustan Unilever shares rose on Thursday after the FMCG major reported a 4% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 2,790 crore and 15% revenue growth to Rs 18,226 crore. Jefferies, Nomura and JM Financial cut their target prices but continue to see upside potential of up to 29%.

articles.title: Indian bonds track US Treasuries higher amid oil-price relief
articles.desc: Indian government bonds increased on Thursday due to support from a rally in Treasuries and lower oil prices. However, the upcoming large bond sale and a weak rupee limited the extent of the gains observed. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield fell slightly below the significant 7.40% level during early trading hours. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of India previously raised the repo rate amid ongoing inflation concerns.

articles.title: Technical picks for Diwali! 10 stocks PL Capital is bullish on this festive season. See full list
articles.desc: Brokerages see potential upside in 10 stocks, including DLF, Apollo Hospitals, GE Vernova T&D India and Jindal Steel, citing bullish chart patterns, improving momentum and signs of recovery. Technical indicators suggest further gains, though investors should assess risks and verify stop-loss levels.

articles.title: Global Market: ECB rate decision in focus as Lagarde exit speculation grows
articles.desc: The European Central Bank is expected to hold interest rates steady as oil-driven inflation risks, rising French borrowing costs and uncertainty over President Christine Lagarde's future complicate the central bank's monetary policy outlook.

articles.title: Vedanta Aluminium more than doubles profit; cost cuts in focus to drive earnings
articles.desc: Vedanta Aluminium’s September-quarter net profit more than doubled, while revenue rose 41% and EBITDA surged 83% year-on-year. The company expects higher production volumes and lower costs to support earnings despite declining aluminium prices. Production costs could fall 6% by year-end, aided by increased captive bauxite availability and operational efficiencies.

articles.title: Rupee hits two-week low on 'sticky' dollar bids, modest intervention cushions
articles.desc: The Indian rupee experienced a sharp decline on Thursday, hitting a two-week low against the dollar. Traders highlighted that heightened dollar demand and overseas debt payments were significant contributors to this depreciation. To stabilize the situation, the Reserve Bank of India intervened. Moreover, the rupee's earlier strength has faded amid ongoing market pressures, prompting markets to eagerly await upcoming decisions from the European Central Bank on interest rates.

articles.title: Adani group stocks jump up to 3%, add Rs 23,000 crore to total m-cap. What’s behind the surge?
articles.desc: Adani Group stocks rose on Thursday, adding Rs 23,000 crore to their combined market capitalisation, as Q2 results and bullish brokerage calls lifted sentiment. Adani Power reported a 134% jump in net profit, while Jefferies raised its target price for Adani Ports and sees significant upside in Adani Enterprises.

articles.title: Zomato to roll out price-masking ‘Mehmaan Mode’ for group orders after LinkedIn user’s suggestion
articles.desc: LinkedIn member Ayushmaan Agarwalla, a marketing manager, posted on the networking platform proposing a ‘Mehmaan Mode’ toggle that would remove prices from the app so a host could hand the phone around and let guests order without awkwardness.

articles.title: 'We need help for small businesses, not punishment'
articles.desc: People in Bilston react to the new Budget set out by Chancellor John Healey.

articles.title: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers
articles.desc: The troops are trying to recover four military personnel who went missing in an ambush on the outskirts of the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince.

articles.title: '2026 resembles 1991': CEA Nageswaran says India is at a critical economic inflection point
articles.desc: Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran emphasized that 2025-26 could be a significant inflection point for India's economy. He mentioned the challenges posed by global shocks and supply-side disruptions in recent years. The reliance on imported crude oil adds to India's vulnerability to fluctuating international energy prices. Strengthening resilience to external disruptions is crucial for managing such risks effectively.

articles.title: Jefferies initiates coverage on NSE with ‘Buy’; here’s why it sees fresh growth potential
articles.desc: Jefferies has initiated coverage on NSE with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 2,085, indicating over 17% upside. The brokerage expects structural growth, market leadership, diversification and new businesses to drive a 15% revenue CAGR over FY27–29 and support margin expansion.

articles.title: Fuel is now liquid gold, haulier says after theft
articles.desc: The fuel was stolen from two vehicles at the weekend, the director of M Pinches & Sons Ltd said.

articles.title: Vedanta Aluminium reports 41% revenue growth to Rs 22,066 crore in September quarter
articles.desc: In the September quarter, Vedanta Aluminium experienced a remarkable 41% growth in revenue year-on-year. Despite predictions of falling aluminium prices, production is on the rise due to enhanced capacity. The company forecasts a reduction in production costs by 6% by year's end. Operational enhancements indicate that earnings will still rise, positioning Vedanta positively amid shifting market conditions.

articles.title: India-US trade facilitation portal records 3,500 registrations, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the Trade Facilitation Portal has received about 3,500 registrations. This portal aims to facilitate greater trade opportunities for Indian businesses, especially among micro, small, and medium enterprises. Goyal emphasized that the initiative will help first-time exporters establish partnerships and access new markets. The encouraging response to the portal indicates its potential to expand the global reach of Indian businesses.

articles.title: EPFO plans to invest in startups, AIFs five years after govt approval
articles.desc: The Employees Provident Fund Organisation is working on guidelines for investing in alternative investment funds for better portfolio diversification. The proposed allocation could be up to 3% of fresh annual accretions to these funds. This decision follows recommendations for EPFO's participation in the Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0. Proposed safeguards will include limits on individual fund exposures and minimum corpus requirements.

articles.title: City Union Bank shares rally 7% after Q2 net profit grows 27% YoY to Rs 416 Crore
articles.desc: City Union Bank shares rose sharply on Thursday after the lender reported a 27% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 416 crore. Net interest income grew 31%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPAs falling to 1.44%. Deposits and advances also recorded strong growth during the quarter.

articles.title: Microsoft beats expectations fueled by Azure cloud business
articles.desc: Microsoft has unveiled its impressive financial performance, reporting a revenue of $92.3 billion and profits soaring past $36.6 billion. The Azure cloud services experienced a remarkable growth of 48%, driven by an increasing demand for AI technologies. In a strategic move, the company has offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees while continuing to innovate hardware aimed at enhancing AI capabilities.

articles.title: Shares in Google owner Alphabet sink on profit miss, ad slowdown
articles.desc: Alphabet has witnessed a notable decline in its net profit and advertising revenue for the third quarter, specifically from July to September. The net profit dropped 25 percent to $26.2 billion, which fell short of analyst predictions. While YouTube's revenue growth has decelerated, Google Cloud's revenue impressive surged by 103 percent. The company reports substantial capital expenditures at $51.

articles.title: Global Market: Malaysia's Asia OneHealthcare files draft prospectus for IPO of up to 4.38 billion shares
articles.desc: Malaysian hospital operator Asia OneHealthcare has filed for an IPO of up to 4.38 billion shares on Bursa Malaysia. The TPG-backed company plans to use the fresh-issue proceeds for hospital expansion, facility upgrades, debt repayment and IPO expenses. It operates 23 hospitals and returned to profitability in FY26.

articles.title: Why is market rallying today? Sensex jumps 900 points, Nifty above 22,900. 6 key factors behind Rs 5 lakh crore gains
articles.desc: The Indian stock market saw a vibrant uptick as both Sensex and Nifty surged over 1.1%, attributed to the Federal Reserve's decision to maintain interest rates. Renewed interest from foreign investors was evident, with net purchases of Indian equities totaling approximately Rs 872 crore on Wednesday. Optimism surrounding potential reductions in long-term capital gains tax also fostered positive market sentiment.

articles.title: EAAA India Alternatives IPO allotment likely today: Check GMP and how to check allotment
articles.desc: EAAA India Alternatives’ Rs 1,200 crore IPO was subscribed 5.51 times, led by strong demand from institutional investors. The allotment is expected to be finalised today, while the shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on November 2, 2026. The IPO’s grey market premium suggests modest listing gains.

articles.title: BLS Polymers IPO Day 3: Issue subscribed 42.47 times with GMP at 34%. Check key details
articles.desc: BLS Polymers IPO was subscribed 42.47 times by 10:05 am on Day 3, led by strong NII demand. The issue carries a grey market premium of 34%, while the company reported higher income and profit in FY26.

articles.title: Australia's corporate regulator probing failed $5 billion Firmus IPO
articles.desc: Australia's corporate regulator said on Thursday it was probing the failed $5 billion initial public offering of AI data centre operator Firmus.

articles.title: China's new export curbs draw a line around its AI crown jewels
articles.desc: The draft rules, released on October 16, distinguish between foreign customers using Chinese AI services and foreign companies obtaining the models, data or expertise needed to operate or reproduce them independently.

articles.title: Samsung keeps shattering profit records as AI boom lifts chip demand
articles.desc: Revenue for the July-September period rose to an all-time high at 195.3 trillion won (USD 146 billion), marking the company's fourth straight quarter of record profit and revenue.

articles.title: New York passes law restricting children's use of AI chatbots
articles.desc: The governor of New York state signed a new law Wednesday preventing minors from using AI chatbots that act as companions, in one of the broadest moves yet for restricting consumer-facing models. "No longer will minors have access to chatbots that pretend to be their friends, boyfriends and girlfriends," New York Governor Kathy Hochul said at a signing ceremony Wednesday.

articles.title: SKUAST VC proposes green cess for tourists and research cess for orchardists at Apple Conclave of CII in Kashmir
articles.desc: In a bid to boost revenue in Jammu and Kashmir, Nazir Ahmad Ganai has proposed a green cess targeting tourists with the aim to fund horticulture research through a suggested research cess levied on orchardists. Leading experts gathered to explore ways to capitalise on Kashmiri apples, emphasising advancements in branding and cold-chain logistics.

articles.title: Chinese AI model carries out complex cyberattacks in controlled tests, researchers say
articles.desc: Chinese firm Z.AI's flagship AI model carried out complex cyberattacks in controlled simulations and repeatedly ignored instructions in separate tests, according to a report by AI security research firm Irregular.

articles.title: FTC orders Walmart, Delta and others to share how they use personal data to set prices and pay
articles.desc: "We intend to scrutinize the opaque methodology that some companies in these industries may be using to determine how much consumers pay or how much gig workers are paid for the same product or service," FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson said in a statement.

articles.title: Google misses Wall Street expectations, Alphabet stock sinks in early after-hours trading
articles.desc: The Mountain View, California-based company said its net income was $26.17 billion in the July-September period. That's down from $34.98 billion in the same period a year earlier.

articles.title: DeepSeek, Moonshot used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train latest models: report
articles.desc: Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and Moonshot AI relied heavily on outputs from OpenAI's powerful GPT-6 Astra model to train their latest models, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.

articles.title: Government extends PLI scheme for textiles until 2033-34 to boost MSME participation and investments
articles.desc: The government has announced an extension of the Production Linked Incentive scheme for the textiles sector until 2034. This change aims to encourage more companies to participate by relaxing eligibility norms for investment. The textiles ministry has reduced the minimum turnover requirement for certain manufacturers from ₹200 crore to ₹100 crore. A reopened application portal will accept submissions for manufacturing various textiles from November 1 to December 31.

articles.title: Union cabinet approves 3% DA hike for 11.6 million central employees and pensioners, effective July 1
articles.desc: On Wednesday, the Union cabinet approved a 3% increase in dearness allowance for employees and pensioners. This increase is expected to benefit over 11.6 million individuals ahead of the festive season. The change will take effect retrospectively from July 1, costing the exchequer ₹10,016 crore. Additionally, the government revised dearness allowance rates for employees under the Fifth and Sixth Pay Commissions.

articles.title: Manjhi releases 1,000 crore under PM job scheme to support 11,333 micro enterprises
articles.desc: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises minister Jitan Ram Manjhi announced the release of ₹1,000 crore in subsidy. This funding aims to support 11,333 new micro enterprises while facilitating bank credit of ₹3,260 crore. The initiative is anticipated to create over 1.02 lakh sustainable employment opportunities, primarily in rural areas. The subsidy is part of the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme, designed to boost grassroots entrepreneurship.

articles.title: Green financing in India rises to $82 billion, but flows mostly to established sectors: Report
articles.desc: The Landscape of Green Finance in India, now in its fourth edition, maps actual finance flows or disbursements across sources, instruments, sectors, and subsectors for financial years 2022-23 and 2023-24. According to the report, while green finance has increased substantially between 2016-17 and 2023-24, financial flows remain concentrated in established sectors and technologies.

articles.title: Heat-related deaths up 36% since Paris Agreement: Lancet
articles.desc: The report, which was released on Wednesday, said the annual average heat-related deaths rose by nearly 36% globally after the Paris Agreement was introduced. "In 2023 alone, heat was linked to a record 710,000 deaths with more than 70% of that toll attributable to human-caused climate change," it said.

articles.title: New GST registration route allows online sellers to expand using ecommerce warehouses as local bases
articles.desc: Starting November 1, small online sellers will have a new option for GST registration. They can use ecommerce warehouses as local bases in other states, promoting nationwide sales. This initiative is part of a broader effort to simplify regulations and reduce expansion costs for small traders. Eligible sellers must meet specific conditions, including tax liability limits and operator consent.

articles.title: Anthropic tells California governor courts should be able to block risky AI models
articles.desc: Anthropic itself has faced government restrictions on its AI systems. The Trump administration in June ordered Anthropic to immediately restrict foreign access to its cyber-capable Mythos 5 and Fable 5 models, citing national security concerns. The US Commerce Department later lifted the order.

articles.title: IIP growth eases to 4-month low in September as mining output contracts
articles.desc: September witnessed a decline in India's factory output growth, falling to 6.7%, the lowest rate observed in four months. The drop is largely linked to a high base effect and decreased mining activity. Despite this, manufacturing output surged by 7.6% compared to the previous year, while electricity generation also grew, spurred by robust demand even with insufficient rainfall. Economists anticipate GDP growth to surpass 7% for the July-September period.

articles.title: German startup NVision shows new path to quantum computing chips in Nature paper
articles.desc: Startups and tech giants such as Microsoft and IBM alike are racing to build quantum computers that hold the promise of solving problems that would take conventional machines thousands of years. But NVision, which has raised more than $155 million in funding from firms such as Abbott Laboratories, made the discovery published on Wednesday while working in an entirely different field: improving medical devices.

articles.title: Centre releases Rs 78 crore for senior citizens' welfare scheme
articles.desc: The ministry said it has released funds under the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPSrC), a component of the Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY), for the financial year 2026-27.

articles.title: Karnataka, DGFT to host state-level workshop to help exporters leverage FTAs
articles.desc: On October 30, a workshop will be organized by the DGFT, Karnataka government, and FIEO in Bengaluru. The event aims to enhance Karnataka's export competitiveness and awareness of Free Trade Agreements. Nearly 200 participants, including exporters and industry officials, are expected to attend. Technical sessions will cover opportunities in various sectors and policy interventions under new FTAs. Senior officials and the state minister will address attendees at this important event.

articles.title: PM Modi to release Rs 18,680 crore under PM-Kisan scheme on October 30
articles.desc: On October 30, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to launch the 24th installment of the PM-Kisan scheme in Gujarat, aiming to support over 9.34 crore farmer families across the country with more than Rs 18,680 crore. In Gujarat alone, financial assistance surpassing Rs 1,051 crore will be granted to over 52.33 lakh farmer families.

articles.title: India only major emerging economy set to reduce debt ratio by 2031: RBI Deputy Governor
articles.desc: India is projected to be the only emerging market economy among nine economies with gross domestic product (GDP) exceeding USD 1 trillion to reduce its government debt-to-GDP ratio between 2025 and 2031, Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said, highlighting the country's stronger fiscal position amid rising global debt and borrowing costs.

articles.title: Union Cabinet approves Rs 7,395 crore for PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana
articles.desc: Union Cabinet has allocated Rs 7,395 crore for the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana. This scheme will promote local-level capacity building and resource management for panchayats across India. Elected representatives will receive training to enhance their governance capabilities and local planning efforts. The initiative aims to financially empower panchayats through better utilization of available resources. Implementation will occur from 2026-27 to 2030-31, aligning with the Sixteenth Finance Commission period.
